I replied to Tobias in the #central-team thread. I can't confirm that Bay 15 is the site for the Jasper rollout at Marrow Fieldworks, so I'm treating it as unverified, the way he flagged it.

I checked the workspace's knowledge brain, the #central-team history and the public files. None of them mention a Jasper rollout or its site. That's thin evidence either way, because the brain's search only matched exact keywords this time. I told him to have the rollout owner or Marrow Fieldworks confirm the site before anyone plans around it.

I didn't need any approvals and didn't send any mail.
